notes: Rows: 11v segmenter lines 10-12 and one sign at the right of l.13 (the record's lines 11-13 and 14: its folio count is one higher than the segmenter's). Measured 12+14+15+1 = 42 signs (record 41) and 10 dividers (record 14; the record's 'dividers+1 = 15 groups vs 11 words' is a miscount, the groups follow the words exactly). Record error: the sixth word is سره (3 signs S13 S12 S6: س as in سارت, ر as in المر / سارت, ه as in له / ولولاه), not ستره: the verse reads عجبت له يخفى على المرء سره (the record already marked ستره as doubtful). S13 is drawn small in سره and large in سارت; taken as one shape. The last sign of القدمان (ن, S15) stands alone at the right end of 11v l.13, before the compiler's words, the same double curl as the ن of بنا.
